details:
My game has never updated many of these lists as I'm playing the game. I'm sure I'm not the only one and I'm sure that many people have similar issues of varying impact.
I don't receive invites from friends unless I restart the game completely when I know I've received one. It makes joining friends in private worlds problematic for me. I don't receive friend requests until I restart the game making many people confused as to why I haven't accepted the request. If a friend switches worlds expecting me to join off them, I have to (surprise!) restart my game completely in order to see their new location. 
I know most people don't have this problem, but I think it wouldn't be a bad idea to implement a reload button to some of these lists (or a reload all lists button) for when I have these problems. If someone else's game has a minor problem (or the same problem as me) and doesn't update something properly, they can reload the list to get it working again.
I know a lot of people may never have to use it, but it also doesn't seem unlikely that anyone might have a small error in the game preventing one thing from loading properly. It would help me a ton, and it could save another user from a frustrating reset.
title: Force reload lists (online friends, friend locations, invites, requests)
